name: Marvo, Deep Operative
oracle_text:
Whenever Marvo attacks, clash with defending player. (Each clashing player reveals the top card of their library, then puts that card on their choice of the top or bottom. A player wins if their card had a greater mana value.)
Whenever you win a clash, draw a card. Then you may cast a spell from your hand with mana value 8 or less without paying its mana cost.
blocked_sentences: Whenever Marvo attacks, clash with defending player.
Whenever you win a clash, draw a card. Then you may cast a spell from your hand with mana value 8 or less without paying its mana cost.

needs.what: a 'wins_clash' trigger event (controller: you) that fires whenever you win any clash, from any source; the engine's op_clash already emits a 'clash' event with player and won=True, so the trigger only has to listen for it
needs.why_existing_wont_do: trigger_events has no clash event; folding the draw/cast into the attack trigger as an `if` on the clash_won binding would miss clashes from every other source, which is an approximation

needs.what: a `player`/`opponent` option on the clash op so it clashes with a named player (here the defending player of the attack trigger) instead of asking 'Clash with which opponent?'; plus the loader must accept a clash whose clash_won binding is read by nobody in the same ability (the win is consumed by a separate trigger)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: op_options lists clash with no options -- it always asks the controller to pick any opponent -- and the loader refuses a clash that no `clash_won` read follows
